thread: Anika: Posting a quick mock for the Compliance panel — mainly two things: the encrypt 'pill' state and the retention preset ordering. PTAL. Jorge: Looks good overall. Quick nit: the KMS pill color is pretty subtle when it's 'customer-managed'. Hard to distinguish for low-vision users. Can we add a clearer icon or stronger contrast? :eyeglasses: Lee: Agreed. Also the current tooltip copy says 'Managed by customer KMS' which reads clunky. Maybe: 'Customer-managed key (KMS) — key stored in your KMS'. Shorter and more actionable. Anika: Good call. Proposed tooltip copy: `Customer-managed key (BYOK). Access controlled by your KMS.` Thoughts? Sam: I like the BYOK mention but avoid acronym first. Suggest: `Customer-managed key (Bring Your Own Key). Access controlled by your KMS.` Also can we update the aria label to be explicit for screen readers: `aria-label=\"Encryption: customer-managed key (BYOK)\"` so VoiceOver announces encryption state early. Jorge: +1 for explicit aria-label. For the visual pill: switch icon to a small lock with a key overlay when BYOK, and use a 3:1 contrast bump from the current background. That keeps brand color but improves accessibility. Kara: On retention presets — currently we show: 30 days, 90 days, 1 year. Product asked to promote 1 year above 90 for enterprise compliance flows. That change breaks alphabetical/chronological expectation. Any objections? Lee: Prefer chronological (short->long). Putting 1 year above 90 days feels odd to users scanning quickly. If we want to promote 1 year, add a subtle badge 'Recommended for compliance' instead of reordering. The badge can be announced by screen readers: `aria-describedby` on the preset. Anika: Good compromise. Mock updated: 1 year keeps position last but has a small shield badge and tooltip: `Recommended for regulated workloads`. Also added `aria-describedby=\"preset-1year-desc\"` with hidden text: `Recommended for regulated workloads; preserves logs longer.` Sam: Minor copy nit for the audit log: the event row currently says `User X changed retention`. Please change to `Actor X updated retention policy` — removes ambiguity (user vs service) and matches our event grammar. Also timestamp format should include timezone abbreviation, e.g., `2024-04-10 14:23 PDT`. Anika: Noted. I'll update the audit schema. For example log line: `Actor: Jane Doe (admin) — Action: Updated retention policy from 30d -> 365d — Time: 2024-04-10 14:23 PDT` — does that look ok? Kara: Looks good. If possible, add a small affordance to expand the row to show the full delta (old vs new) and which route/service the change applied to. That helps audits during reviews. Jorge: One more a11y check — keyboard focus order on the panel currently flows: region dropdown -> retention preset -> encrypt pill. Need to ensure encrypt pill is reachable via Tab before the Save button, and its tooltip is keyboard-triggerable (focus/enter shows the tooltip). Lee: Implementation note: use `button` for the pill with `aria-pressed` false/true for states and a `aria-haspopup="dialog"` if it opens a modal.
